verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an agentic automation platform like Perplexity Computer, but the evidence pack never documents automation versions, change review, or rollback. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: thread_id session continuation and approve/deny of individual sensitive actions, which approves one-off actions rather than reviewing automation definitions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
